about.title: About Koe
about.privacyBody: Koe has no backend. There is no server that can receive your audio or transcript. All processing happens inside your browser using WebAssembly. The only network requests are: loading this site, and downloading the speech model you explicitly choose. No telemetry, no analytics, no cookies, no accounts.
about.offlineBody: After the model is downloaded once, Koe works fully offline. Install it as a PWA for the best experience.
about.unlimitedBody: No quotas, no subscriptions, no per-minute fees. Koe is open source under the MIT license.
about.nameBody: Koe (声) means voice in Japanese. It is the lighter sibling of Kikoe, the command line tool.
about.licensesBody: Koe is MIT licensed. It builds on Whisper by OpenAI (MIT), ONNX Runtime Web (MIT), Hugging Face Transformers.js (Apache-2.0), React (MIT), and Tailwind CSS (MIT). Font: Nunito (SIL Open Font License), self-hosted.

help.title: Help
help.browserBody: Latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari on desktop. Android Chrome works with a memory warning. iOS Safari is experimental. Multi-threading needs cross-origin isolation headers, which this site sends.
help.modelBody: Tiny is fastest and smallest. Base is a good default. Small is the most accurate of the three but downloads about 242 MB and needs more memory. When in doubt, start with Base.
help.memoryBody: Audio is decoded fully in memory, so very long files (over 30 minutes) may fail on devices with little memory. Use Tiny, close other tabs, or trim the file first.
help.formatBody: TXT is plain text. SRT and VTT are subtitles with timestamps. JSON contains per-segment timestamps for further processing.
help.privacyBody: No. Nothing is uploaded. You can verify this yourself: open your browser's network tab and watch zero requests while transcribing.
help.troubleBody: Stuck or crashed? Reload the page. The model stays cached. If a download was interrupted, just press download again. If transcription fails on a long file, try a smaller model.
